notes.title: Small fix update notes for March 15 2023
notes.content:
A small bug fix update:
- Fixed a possible bug in controller focus in cut scenes.
- Fixed a cache bug when restarting games.

notes.title: Roller Drama Officially Steam Deck Verified! Plus Clear Texts Update
notes.content:
For this update, we worked on optimizing readability and font quality rendering, which was sub-optimal for Chinese and Japanese fonts.
Now the latter don't rely on fallbacks for missing characters so the overall experience should be better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/05453e8e1809e6c3b918340f4795f1687e375237.jpg

Plus, Roller Drama got a "Steam Deck verified" check! Playing matches on a Steam Deck should be even better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/f00e2ec242f034a869d48e7eb4ecf8da6fd6785f.jpg

Also,  a host of little fixes and improvements:

 Little fix when opening and closing meta panels.
 Clearer icons for selecting and deselecting special actions in matches.
 Fixed order of card selection in matches.
 Fixed a bug when opening the Mental State panel and then attempting to close it with "B" on the controller.


Last but not least, a sale is now running, and the Spring one is not far too...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/1a8395693e41e253e47a84e0e4c78bb9a4f15d78.jpg

notes.title: Update with fixes for February 8, 2023
notes.content:
Little fix when opening and closing meta panels.

notes.title: First patch after release
notes.content:
This patch fixes the following:
- Your team name was not saved - sorry for that!!!
- Labels for controller bumpers/triggers in the blockers' controls when switching in real-time ("B" on the controller) were swapped.
- If you quickly opened/closed the inventory you could break controller focus.

notes.title: Fixes and extensions after Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
So Steam Next Fest is over: thank you to all who played our demo, we are going to keep it available for a while.

Thanks to the feedback received in this forum thread, we did some bug fixes and extensions: if you have the demo in your library, it will update with the following:

 A fix on the labels of the trigger and bumper buttons.
 A new panel for remapping controller buttons and keyboard keys.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/778e5db705f094808e8ad42b65902b232082ba21.jpg

So we hope you have enjoyed the demo, its just a very small part of the gameplay, please add our game to your wishlist, it will be out in the very first months of 2023.

notes.title: Roller Drama's Demo For Steam Next Fest Is Available Now!
notes.content:
In this demo, you will watch the introduction, play the first (easy) quest, and the first match. You will have access to the exploration of the general team mind state, quest story, inventory, and championship standing. Of course, you will need a longer gameplay to experience their application.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/d545fd2c8e9f128fe0a6ad17508bd4a749acf95f.gif

We just want to point out a limit of the demo: in this kind of gameplay experience, familiarity with the characters and the progressive immersion in the story is a considerable part of the fun of it, and the limits of the demo will not get you fully into that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/12efde2ef5d3b168449d0be7eb090d252598aeaa.jpg

A couple of more things: 

 This demo also runs on the Steam Deck!
 The demo is English only (sorry), but we'll release Roller Drama in eight languages!
 Achievements and saves are disabled in the demo, but of course they will be there on release.


If you are a reviewer and need a more extended gameplay or any other material, just write to games@open-lab.com.
Please do wishlist and share this game, its coming out really soon!!!
